description.en: Cursor Connect-RPC fingerprint, in-band error classification, usage windows and model catalog.
description.zh: Cursor Connect-RPC 指纹、带内错误分类、用量窗口与模型目录。

docs.en: Import an account from Cursor IDE. This package sets Connect-RPC headers, classifies in-band errors, and polls quota and models.
docs.zh: 从 Cursor IDE 导入账号。本包设置 Connect-RPC 请求头、分类带内错误，并轮询配额与模型目录。

description.en: Copy Cursor's access token from its local sign-in state.
description.zh: 从 Cursor 本地登录状态中复制访问令牌。

help_text.en: cursorAuth/accessToken in Cursor's state.vscdb (User/globalStorage), or the cursor-access-token keychain item. A Machine ID used to be required with it; the wire no longer sends one.
help_text.zh: 取自 Cursor state.vscdb（User/globalStorage）的 cursorAuth/accessToken，或钥匙串 cursor-access-token 项。旧版需要的 Machine ID 已不再上电线。
